precedence_declaration.declared_in: this file, q01.declared_precedence (ordered, first match wins)
precedence_declaration.requirement: the reference implementation MUST refuse to run if this block is absent, empty or non-totally ordered; it MUST NOT fall back to a built-in precedence
precedence_declaration.tie_break_within_a_region: none: R2 and R3 are disjoint by construction (competing vs concordant); no inter-terminal ordering is ever applied

domain_definitions.D_STEM: the stem's own instruction: affiliations only (63) or exactly one terminal alone when nothing applies (3) = 66 admissible non-empty answers
domain_definitions.D_AFFORDANCE: type multi_select_with_exclusive_terminals + exclusive_codes + max_selections=null: non-empty selections with at most one terminal = 255, plus 1 empty input state = 256 input states
domain_definitions.D_POWERSET: all 2^9 = 512 subsets of items[0].codes (capture-surface domain, not an answer domain)
domain_definitions.governing_definition_for_coverage: D_POWERSET for the robustness record; D_STEM for admissibility; D_AFFORDANCE for the denominator of answer states
domain_definitions.note: the contract claims totality over D_POWERSET (items[0].eligibility_effect.disposition_rule.totality); this spec quotes that claim and tests it rather than assuming it

answer_state_rule.rule: Q01 answer_state is a function of the matched disposition rule (see declared_precedence[].answer_state), not of the substantive/non_substantive code lists
answer_state_rule.why_needed: items[0] carries NO option_to_state_map and NO refusal_route; refusal_and_state_semantics.answer_state_precedence_rule supplies no precedence for an answer SET that is simultaneously substantive and non-substantive. 441 of 512 subsets mix an affiliation with a terminal and therefore have no determinable state under the frozen fallback.

counter_separation.concordant_multi_terminal: counted in its own MULTI_TERMINAL_CONCORDANT partition; MUST NOT be reported as a RARELY, NEVER or NOT_SURE single-terminal screen-out (items[0].permitted_claim requires SEPARATE counts)
counter_separation.competing_multi_terminal: counted only in the INVALID / SCREEN_INVALID partition; never in any terminal counter
